items.source: This configuration causes the base packages to be scanned for interfaces that extend contain LDAP repositories and create Spring beans for each one found.

items.source: Explicitly wire the LdapTemplate to be used with the repositories being detected by the repositories element. Usually used if multiple LdapTemplate beans are used within the application. If not configured, Spring Data automatically looks up the LdapTemplate bean with the name ldapTemplate in the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 显式配置 `LdapTemplate` 以与由 `repositories` 元素检测到的存储库配合使用。通常在应用程序中使用多个 `LdapTemplate` Bean 时采用此方式。如果未进行配置，Spring Data 会自动在 `ApplicationContext` 中查找名为 `ldapTemplate` 的 `LdapTemplate` Bean。

items.source: To include support for LdapQuery parameters in automatically generated repositories, have your interface extend LdapRepository rather than CrudRepository.
items.translation: 要在自动生成的仓库中支持 `<code>LdapQuery` 参数，请让您的接口继承 `<code>LdapRepository` 而不是 `<code>CrudRepository`。

items.source: Indeed, the built-in LdapRepository only takes one type parameter: the managed entity class, which defaults the ID to javax.naming.Name.
items.translation: 确实，内置的LdapRepository仅接受一个类型参数：即托管实体类，其 ID 默认为javax.naming.Name。

items.source: By default, the repositories get an autowired LdapTemplate Spring bean that is called ldapTemplate, so you only need to configure ldap-template-ref explicitly if you deviate from this convention.
items.translation: 默认情况下，仓库会自动注入一个名为ldapTemplate的Spring Bean类型的，因此只有当您需要偏离此约定时，才需要显式配置ldap-template-ref。

items.source: All Spring LDAP repositories must work with entities annotated with the ODM annotations, as described in Object-Directory Mapping.
items.translation: 所有 Spring LDAP 存储库都必须与使用 ODM 注解标记的实体一起工作，如对象目录映射中所描述的那样。

items.source: Since all ODM managed classes must have a Distinguished Name as the ID, all Spring LDAP repositories must have the ID type parameter set to javax.naming.Name.
items.translation: 由于所有 ODM 管理的类都必须使用区分名称（Distinguished Name）作为标识符，因此所有 Spring LDAP 存储库的 ID 类型参数必须设置为 `javax.naming.Name`。

items.source: Spring Data LDAP requires a LdapMappingContext bean named ldapMappingContext to be present. If no such bean is defined, then Spring Data LDAP registers a default instance in the application context.
items.translation: Spring Data LDAP 需要一个名为 ldapMappingContext 的 LdapMappingContext Bean。如果未定义此类 Bean，则 Spring Data LDAP 将在应用程序上下文中注册一个默认实例。

items.source: You must use ODM annotations, such as org.springframework.ldap.odm.annotations.Id. Using Spring Data’s annotation does not work, because Spring LDAP uses its own mapping layer.
items.translation: 您必须使用 ODM 注解，例如 org.springframework.ldap.odm.annotations.Id。 使用 Spring Data 的注解不起作用，因为 Spring LDAP 拥有自己的映射层。

items.source: Which is better, JavaConfig or XML? XML is how Spring was configured long ago. In today’s era of fast-growing Java, record types, annotations, and more, new projects typically use as much pure Java as possible. While there is no immediate plan to remove XML support, some of the newest features MAY not be available through XML.
items.translation: JavaConfig 和 XML 哪个更好？ XML 是 Spring 早期使用的配置方式。 在当今 Java 飞速发展的时代，随着记录类型、注解等新特性的出现，新项目通常尽可能多地使用纯 Java 代码。 虽然目前没有立即移除 XML 支持的计划，但部分最新功能可能无法通过 XML 实现。
